scope: 36 sampled frames across coast and fleet on phone and fallback. Temporal ordering reviewed from sampled PNGs.
verdict: Small positive HUD clearance in both tiers. Keep the label clearance change. Core rendering, player tracking, damage feedback and depth cues match the prior samples.
changes: Coast 180: Hawk label no longer crosses the Return to Base banner on phone or fallback.
Fleet 120: Hawk label no longer touches the minimap edge on phone or fallback. It appears again at 180 when clear.
remaining: The brief solid-white aircraft silhouette at frames 006 and 012 coincides with a hull loss and reads as damage feedback, but temporarily erases airframe detail. Dark or blue offset marks in fleet samples still merit checking against continuous playback.
The faint circle on the runway can read as an unexplained HUD mark. Brackets remain helpful as aircraft bank and cross a deck.
Fallback foliage and deck markings are visibly softer. Major effects remain readable.
